personality_one_liner: A high-performance operational command center for independent personal trainers to manage student rosters, body composition diagnostics, and workout prescriptions with zero friction.

spacing.rule: Maintain disciplined 8pt grid with compact high-density metrics and generous touch targets (≥44pt).

do's: Use crisp borders and tonal contrast for high-speed glanceability during live training.
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs that reduce clarity on quick data scans.

screens.name: Dashboard & Alerts
screens.purpose: Command center for the personal trainer displaying critical alerts, active student roster, quick stats, and AI assistant suggestions.

states.loading: Displaying skeleton rows for active roster and alert priority badges.
states.empty: No active student alerts or pending tasks. All rosters synced.
states.error: Failed to sync roster data. Tap retry to reconnect.

screens.layout: Sticky header with trainer quick status, alert banner carousel for payment/plan/inactivity, search bar, active students horizontal quick scroll, and priority student list with status tags.

screens.name: Student Profile & History
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of student details, anamnesis summary, chronic chronological workout history, and quick action triggers.

states.loading: Loading student telemetry and past session logs...
states.empty: No history recorded yet for this student.
states.error: Could not load student record. Please check connection.

screens.layout: Header with avatar and quick contact buttons, segmented tab bar (Overview, Training, Physical Assessment, Anamnesis), and chronological timeline feed.

screens.name: Physical Assessment (Pollock & Body Composition)
screens.purpose: Advanced assessment module featuring Pollock 3 & 7 folds protocols, circumferences, fat mass, lean mass, and BMI telemetry.

states.empty: No physical assessments recorded. Tap 'Nova Avaliação' to start.
states.error: Calculation error in skinfold algorithms. Re-enter measurements.

screens.layout: Protocol selector toggle (Pollock 3 / 7), interactive input grid for skinfold/circumference numbers, live summary calculation card showing fat mass percentage, lean mass, and BMI status badge.

screens.name: Minha Evolução (Comparison & Charts)
screens.purpose: Comparative analytics view graphing body composition shifts over time with visual progress indicators.

states.empty: At least two assessments are required to generate comparison trends.

screens.layout: Date range picker, key metric cards with delta percentage indicators (Weight, Fat %, Muscle Mass), and interactive timeline evolution graph.

screens.name: Antes e Depois (Side-by-Side Photo Comparison)
screens.purpose: Visual comparison tool showing frontal, lateral, and posterior photos side-by-side with date stamps and alignment grid.

states.empty: No progress photos uploaded yet for this student.

screens.layout: Dual-frame comparison viewer with date selectors (Before vs After), angle switcher pills (Frontal, Lateral, Posterior), and slider overlay.

screens.name: Workout Builder & Tracker
screens.purpose: Detailed workout programming interface with exercise sets, reps, load, rest times, and tempo control.

states.loading: Loading workout templates and exercise library...
states.empty: No exercises added to this workout routine yet.

screens.layout: Routine header with target muscle group and duration, expandable exercise list cards with set tables (Weight x Reps x Rest), and sticky bottom action bar.

screens.name: Frequency & Calendar
screens.purpose: Attendance tracking and training calendar showing session completion history and schedule.

states.empty: No attendance records found for this month.

screens.layout: Monthly calendar grid with presence status indicators (green completed, red missed, amber scheduled) and daily session log below.

screens.name: AI Assistant & Chat
screens.purpose: Direct messaging with students and AI assistant powered hub for instant workout adjustments and movement analysis.

states.loading: Connecting to AI coach and secure chat...
states.empty: Start a conversation or ask the AI assistant for a workout variation.

screens.layout: Segmented switcher (AI Support vs Student Chat), message stream with markdown code blocks and quick action prompt chips, and sticky message input box.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build ApexTrainer OS using Dark-First Utility theme with a warm signal orange accent (#FF5722) for high-performance workout and roster management.
Ensure all 8 core screens are fully interactive and wired up with realistic mock data for Brazilian personal trainers (Portuguese UI text as requested in problem statement).
Implement Pollock 3 and 7 folds skinfold calculation formulas, circumference logs, and BMI/fat mass calculations.
Include Antes e Depois photo comparison side-by-side view, Anamnese form, Workout programming with sets/reps/load, Frequency calendar, Direct Chat, and AI Assistant support.
Adhere strictly to touch targets >= 44pt, safe area handling at screen roots, and no purple/indigo/navy banned colors.
